Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling through an intersection in Houston, Texas, and was struck while making a left turn by a vehicle
operated by Driver 2. Upon arrival, I observed both vehicles in the roadway and spoke with the drivers at the scene.
Driver 1 reported pain in the lower back and said the impact jolted the body forward and against the seatbelt. The
reported injury is consistent with the type and force of a collision of this kind. Damage to the front driver side of Driver
1's vehicle matches the impact described by both parties, and I found no indication of earlier damage to that area.
Photographs taken at the scene confirm the general positions of the vehicles and the visbile damage, though no
independent witnesses came forward. Police records and statements from both drivers confirm that a Passenger was
seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the crash. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the insurance policy
covering the vehicle. No citations were issued at the scene pending further review of the collision.
</page>
